blocks.text: What is customer success manager in Salesforce

When you ask what is customer success manager in Salesforce, you are looking at a professional who uses the platform to track account health, manage onboarding, and ensure renewals. In practice, this means you spend your day inside the Salesforce browser tab. You move data between your email, your project management tools, and the Salesforce interface. The platform serves as your central source of truth for every client interaction.
The cost of manual CRM workflows

Manual work is the hidden tax on your success. You likely spend up to 12 hours a week just typing info into fields. This is time you could spend talking to clients. When you force yourself to do this, you lose focus on the strategy. You become a data clerk instead of a partner to your clients. This leads to burnout where 47 percent of CSMs feel overwhelmed by the sheer volume of admin tasks.

Automation often breaks because of process debt. You might try to automate a workflow that is already messy. If your data is bad, the automation just makes it worse. You end up sending incorrect emails to clients who are already upset. Never automate a broken process. First, audit your fields and remove duplicates. Clean data is the foundation of any good CRM setup.
Before you build a flow, check your data quality. Use a simple spreadsheet to audit your most used fields. If the data is not standardized, your automation will send the wrong messages.

blocks.text: How Lazur helps you on Mac

Lazur lives in your Mac notch and helps you manage your CRM tasks by voice. If you are stuck in a complex Salesforce menu, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask where a specific setting is. Lazur circles it for you. If you need to draft an email based on CRM data, hold fn and dictate your message. It stays in the flow of work so you do not have to switch apps constantly.
